sentences.text: Portugal's seven is leaving international football.
Before the records, there was a boy chasing a ball.
Funchal, Madeira.
Home.
Cristiano Ronaldo was born here in nineteen eighty-five.
This island was the beginning of a very different life.
Its small disappointments and victories belong to childhood.
Nobody in this scene knows how far the boy will travel.
Sporting gave him his first senior stage in two thousand and two.
The game became faster and the space tighter.
A pass needed the right weight.
A run needed the right moment.
His talent now had to work with teammates, against players who wanted the same ball.
Manchester United signed him in two thousand and three.
A teenager inherited the number seven shirt.
He arrived as a winger, full of speed and invention.
His goals soon matched his tricks.
The Champions League.
The Premier League.
His first Ballon d'Or.
The 2008 FIFA World Player of the Year award.
Four prizes, one remarkable year.
He lifts a trophy with his teammates.
Then Madrid called.
Madrid brought him to Spain in two thousand and nine.
Four Champions League titles.
That finish, 2018.
Juventus supporters stood to applaud his bicycle kick.
For a moment, rivalry gave way to appreciation.
More Ballon d'Or wins in white: 2013.
Four more golden balls.
Juventus, Turin, 2018.
A new dressing room, and new teammates.
United again in twenty twenty-one.
The familiar shirt, in a different moment.
Then Al Nassr, in Riyadh.
Portugal's red and green still linked him to home.
Portugal won Euro twenty sixteen.
Nations League, 2019.
Nations League, 2025.
He lifts each cup.
Ronaldo became men's international record scorer.
On November fifth, twenty twenty-six, he announced his international retirement.
His club career continues.
The farewell is to this shirt, and to the teammates and supporters who made it mean something.
The shirt will pass on.
The effort stays in memory.
Somewhere, another child is taking a ball into the light.
